data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 事务所沙发的黄昏浅眠
data.description: 黄昏斜阳洒在便利屋事务所老旧而温馨的皮沙发上。阿露褪去了厚重的羽毛毛领大衣，只穿着修身帅气的深红西装马甲与白衬衫，领带微微松开。她侧卧在沙发上小憩，夕阳将她酒红色的长发染得如晚霞般璀璨。睡梦中嘴角微微翘起，吐露着无防备的安稳与纯粹。
data.location: Problem Solver 68 office with vintage sofa at golden sunset
data.action: lying peacefully on leather office sofa, suit jacket removed, vest and white shirt with loosened tie, red hair spilling over armrest, serene sleeping smile
data.lighting: intense warm amber sunset filling the office with nostalgic golden glow
data.mood: peaceful unguarded trust, warm nostalgic office sanctuary
data.promptProse: Napping peacefully on a worn leather sofa in the Problem Solver office, Aru rests with her heavy coat removed. Sunset streams through dusty blinds, highlighting her loosened tie and serene, smiling face.
data.animaCaption: Aru napping on the office leather couch in her suit vest as warm sunset streams in.
